Cell Salts

Remedy cell-salts homeopathic electrolyte-balance edema

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Biochemical tissue salts (Schuessler salts) that help regulate fluid balance and cellular function in the body.

Indications

  • edema
  • fluid retention
  • electrolyte imbalance

Contraindications

  • severe kidney disease

Preparations

  • tablet
  • pellet
  • liquid

Body Systems Affected

  • renal
  • circulatory
  • cellular

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Edema, Fluid Retention
    Excess fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling, typically in legs, ankles, or abdomen. Can be caused by heart conditions, kidney dysfunction, liver disease, or medication side effects.
